messages:
Rowan: Dropping a compact invite drawer mock. Need quick decisions: show SSO status as a badge vs toggle, keyboard order for role chips, and whether "View changes" deep-links to Audit Logs or shows a tiny inline changelog. Figma: https://figma.com/file/invite-compact-ux Mira: Vote for a non-interactive badge that is tabbable. If a user tries to change SSO show a modal that explains it's org-scoped and offers a link to Org Settings. Avoid exposing a toggle here. Devon: Agree. Tab order should prioritize form fields: email -> role multiselect -> SSO badge -> send. Role chips need arrow-key nav and Enter to select. Badge must be reachable and announce its state. Asha: Accessibility: badge contrast fails at small sizes; use a darker text token or light bg to hit 4.5:1. Make focus outline 3px solid and ensure the modal is focus-trapped. Also toasts must use aria-live="polite" and not steal focus. Noah: Backend: we can deep-link to Audit Logs with params (actorId, action=invite, roleId, start, end). Also can return the last 3 audit events for a compact inline summary in the confirmation panel. Recommend both: inline preview + "View full audit" deep-link. Rowan: Copy ask: change toast from "Invites sent" to "Invites queued recipients will receive emails shortly." Add a persistent "View invite status" link inside the drawer so keyboard users have a target. Mira: For the badge modal copy: heading "SSO enforcement is organization-wide" and body "SSO is managed in Organization settings. Changes affect all members." Primary CTA: "Go to Organization settings". Ensure the CTA is keyboard-focusable first. Devon: ARIA snippet for the badge -> modal: ```
...
``` Esc should close modal and return focus to badge. Asha: I'll run an a11y check on the updated frame once Mira posts it. Checklist items: contrast 4.5:1, 3px focus ring, tabindex order, aria-live for toast, modal trapping. CIbot: Visual regression: invite-compact failed on badge contrast and focus ring thickness. See snapshot: https://ci.internal/snapshots/2165432100/diff.png Rowan: Action items: Mira update Figma with tabbable badge + modal copy, Devon add keyboard/ARIA snippets and chip arrow nav notes, Asha run accessibility pass, Noah add audit preview API examples. Follow-up tomorrow 10:30am PT to review frames. :thumbsup: Mira: Will update and ping here when done. Devon: Adding notes to PR. Asha: Will run axe after updates. Noah: Drafting deep-link examples and preview endpoint now. Rowan: Thanks everyone, closing thread unless blockers appear.
